title: Git integration and landing
note: The merge audit reads a project-scoped registered snapshot over HTTPS or local dispatch, then checks Git branches, dirt and conflicts on the client. It refuses an unavailable snapshot with a named recovery; source proof does not establish deployed availability. A merge-lock refusal preserves the holder message and teaches that no wake will arrive: rerun the same merge command in a few minutes. It reports the configured merge_lock_ttl_minutes expiry limit (default 30 minutes).
